UpdateStageName: Validate Freelancer Files and Handle EULA
UpdateSourceArgs: -c "BASE=\"{{$FullBaseDir}}game\"; EXE=\"$BASE/EXE/FLServer.exe\"; if [ ! -f \"$EXE\" ]; then echo \"Freelancer server files are missing: $EXE\" >&2; exit 1; fi; EULA=$(find \"$BASE\" -maxdepth 2 -type f -iname 'ebueula.dll' -print -quit 2>/dev/null); if [ -z \"$EULA\" ]; then echo \"No EBUEula.dll found - skipping EULA patch\"; exit 0; fi; HASH=$(sha256sum \"$EULA\" | awk '{print $1}'); if [ \"$HASH\" = \"9887a4ef2fa49009fe593b0a6483acd742424621fd79593067b1499ebc53aa01\" ]; then B=$(od -An -tx1 -j $((0x217d)) -N 1 \"$EULA\" | tr -d '[:space:]'); if [ \"$B\" != \"00\" ]; then echo \"Unexpected vanilla EBUEula.dll byte at 0x217D: $B\" >&2; exit 1; fi; printf '\\001' | dd of=\"$EULA\" bs=1 seek=$((0x217d)) conv=notrunc status=none || exit 1; echo \"Patched vanilla EBUEula.dll: $EULA\"; else echo \"Non-vanilla or already patched EBUEula.dll detected ($HASH) - leaving unchanged: $EULA\"; fi"
